question: How much language/communication competence exists before N1 learning begins?

prior_classes.detail: The historical bounded-world bootstrap supplies English function words plus all microworld nouns/adjectives/verbs.
Productive English -ed/participle rules and irregular did/was plus verb exceptions are authored.
NP, transitive, intransitive, passive, negation, yes/no and wh-object form-meaning mappings encode English word order and roles.
Ambiguity retention, warrant selection and construction matching are general mechanisms; whitespace/lowercase/punctuation tokenization is a declared corpus adapter, not learned competence.
Current realizer directly authors English determiners, active/passive order, did-not contraction choice and question order.
ASSERT/ANSWER/ASK/CLARIFY/etc. are a fixed taxonomy. Epistemic commitment markers may remain constitutional, but the full interaction inventory is prior structure.
English pronoun feature mappings, determiners and ordinal descriptions are authored.
Information-value selection is language-general, while binary question wording and interaction conventions are authored.
ANSWER/ELABORATION/CONTRAST/LIST/TEACH_BACK planning, explanation depth, register length targets and ordering obligations are authored.
World relation phrases, uncertainty/reporting/citation text and contextual response phrasings are authored English.

DialogueSession records interpreted statements as OBSERVATION said-records with conversation scope and fixed speaker-axis rank 1. This is authored source-authority bookkeeping, not learned language or independent world-truth authority (world_truth rank 0); speaker identity remains in the source and payload.

retain_constitutional_or_language_genera: MeaningGraph data model and exact canonical checking
Lexeme/MorphRule/Construction object schemas without English instances
generic parser/chart algorithm once its grammar is supplied by learned objects
dataset_adapter_not_cognitive_constituti: UD-provided token boundaries/tags when explicitly counted as teacher annotation
UTF-8/text normalization required to read a registered corpus

required_ablations_before_strong_claim: full historical bootstrap versus N1 minimal arm
remove seed construction families and test acquisition recovery
remove English morphology and test induction/recovery
fixed-template realizer versus learned realization in N2
